the proposed approach provides a flexible, computationally feasible, and robust method for Bayesian inference in SPMMs for longitudinal data.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the commonly used DP prior for the random effect distribution in SPMMs can result in biased inference for the regression parameters and the spline estimator.
the proposed approach can provide a more accurate estimation of the nonparametrized random effect distribution and a better inference for the parametric fixed effects than the existing approaches.
the USP can be used in conjunction with a nonparametric random effect distribution to obtain proper posteriors and good finite sample performance.
